name: Crushed-sherd Grog
prompt:
Create ONE Tomorrow and Tomorrow research painting. Reference supplies ONLY field medium/palette and EXACT EXTRA-WIDE canvas. Preserve its width and aspect, full bleed, no frame/text/grid/3:2 output. NEW SUBJECT: Two potters crush broken rough fired clay sherds with a hand pebble on a low flat stone; coarse crushed pieces and a lump of wet clay close together. Flat angular palette-knife copper/ember/soot planes, genuinely painted surfaces, NO 3D relief or photography. No kiln, metal hammer, wheel, fancy vessels or refined bench.
CRITICAL composition: complete main heads, hands, working mechanism all within central y170..590 on a 765px-high banner; zoom out to fit actual 3.37:1 research card crop. Background only above and below that band. Game years23–25: hides, cordage, baskets, early pottery, modest earthen huts; plain weaving comes later. Do not borrow later reference technology.
review: Approved after full-canvas and actual 3.37:1 private GPU card review; complete heads and practical mechanism retained. Clean import, headless/GPU PASS14.
